name: changelog-generator
description: Use when the user wants to generate a changelog, release notes, what's new document, or any summary of recent changes for end users. Trigger when the user says things like "generate a changelog", "write release notes", "what changed since the last release", "create a CHANGELOG entry", "summarize recent git commits for users", "write up the changes for v1.2.0", "prepare release documentation", or anything about translating git history into user-facing communication. Also trigger if the user is preparing a GitHub release, writing a What's New page, or asking what went into a release. Use this skill whenever the conversation involves git history and communicating changes to end users.
author: JJ Halans
triggers: what changed since the last release
summarize recent git commits for users
write up the changes for v1.2.0
translate git history into release notes

usage.prompt: Determine the commit range (default to last tag..HEAD or use user-specified range), collect commits with --no-merges, categorize changes into Breaking Changes/New Features/Bug Fixes/Improvements, rewrite items in user-facing language, consolidate related commits, and output markdown release notes with only non-empty sections.

repoPath.description: Path to the git repository to summarize.

range.description: Optional commit range (for example v1.2.0..HEAD, main..feature, or --since expression).

releaseLabel.description: Optional version/date label for the changelog header (for example v1.3.0 or Unreleased).

markdown.description: Customer-facing changelog markdown with categorized sections and concise bullet points.

suggestedVersionBump.description: Optional semantic version bump suggestion based on commit categories (major, minor, or patch).
